hero.title: PointerGuard Router (Controlled Beta)
hero.subtitle: Condition-based token/input compression with automatic fallback and operational guardrails.
hero.status_line: Current status: readiness=green, controlled beta recommended.

fact_lock_bullets: This service is promoted with measured evidence only (Fact-Lock).
When guard conditions are unmet, traffic is downgraded to safe fallback mode automatically.
Public benchmark uses synthetic/anonymized input scope only.
No guarantee of universal uplift outside validated operating conditions.
claims: Conditional cost and latency improvement in validated operating zones.
Automatic safety fallback (HOLD/track_a_primary) when readiness or health checks fail.
Operational transparency via timestamped benchmark and readiness artifacts.
non_claims: No claim that all workloads receive equal benefit.
No exposure of private corpora, secrets, or internal codebook internals.

cta.label: Request Controlled Beta
cta.note: Pilot onboarding is limited to scoped B2B workloads with monitoring and guardrail acceptance.
